answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Trust flows along the graph and thins with distance: a newcomer endorsed only by fresh keys carries no weight. A farm must recruit 8 real sponsors per alias or sit unendorsed, and tight clusters that vouch only for each other are detected and paid as one. Branches that never touch the trusted core earn nothing at all. A jade of doubt is healthy, a zenith of proof is required, and a fable of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
